description: How the parties around HCI's platform relate to each other: how GP practices and pharmacies open the digital front door for patients, how patients book, measure and exercise with their therapist, how referrals and reports flow through the care network, how GGZ practitioners and institutions treat, share and collaborate, how integration partners reach every label through the open platform, and how HCI's implementation and support staff onboard, migrate and keep declarations flowing.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Contracts, label choices, partner agreements, website and subscription decisions

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Referrals, bookings, treatments, declarations, migrations, integrations and support handled day to day

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Patient invoices, insurer and municipal claims, billing services and partner transactions

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Reports, outcomes, shared records, release notices, questions and regulatory changes

relations.name: Offers the digital front door to the patient
relations.description: Invites patients to Uw Zorg Online from the practice website and the HIS or AIS, so that e-consults, appointments in the practice agenda, repeat prescriptions and digital triage replace routine phone calls.

relations.name: Sends e-consults, booking and repeat-prescription requests
relations.description: Uses the app to ask care questions, book a slot in the practice agenda, order repeat medication and answer the 'Moet ik naar de dokter?' triage questions, which land directly in the HIS or AIS work list instead of on the 8 o'clock phone line.

relations.name: Refers patients through ZorgDomein
relations.description: Sends referrals and secure messages for physiotherapy through ZorgDomein and ZorgMail, and expects a report back when the episode closes.

relations.name: Reports treatment outcomes back to the referrer
relations.description: Returns intake findings, progress and discharge reports to the GP through ZorgMail from the dossier, closing the referral loop without extra typing.

relations.name: Books online, completes PROMs and home exercises
relations.description: Books and reschedules 24/7 through the practice website, fills in measurement questionnaires before and after treatment and follows the exercise programme between sessions, feeding the dossier and the quality data.

relations.name: Invoices non-reimbursed treatments and subscriptions
relations.description: Sends patient invoices with a Mollie payment link for treatments outside the insurance contract, group lessons and subscriptions, generated from the agenda.

relations.name: Subscribes to exercise-app and quality-register connections
relations.description: Activates Physitrack or another exercise programme, Qualiview or MediQuest surveys and the Twinfield accounting link from within the EPD and expects them to keep working after each release.

relations.name: Delivers exercise programmes and survey results into the dossier
relations.description: Pushes assigned exercise programmes, home-task progress and patient-experience results back into the patient dossier through the partner API.

relations.name: Exchanges referrals and reports for speech, OT and dietetics
relations.description: Receives referrals for speech therapy, occupational therapy, exercise therapy or dietetics and returns discipline-specific reports so the GP does not have to register twice.

relations.name: Sends discharge and follow-up reports after rehabilitation
relations.description: Reports the multidisciplinary trajectory outcome and the remote follow-up plan from ParaNICE to the GP when a patient leaves the hospital or rehabilitation department.

relations.name: Follows the patient remotely after discharge
relations.description: Runs NICE Connect remote trajectories with video consultations, home tasks and measurements so the patient continues rehabilitation at home.

relations.name: Registers through the client portal and completes ROM
relations.description: Self-schedules the intake, sends secure messages, fills in ROM questionnaires and works through Embloom modules between sessions of the treatment.

relations.name: Joins regional collaboration on waiting lists and referrals
relations.description: Shares waiting-time information per treatment type and refers clients between the independent practice and the institution in the regional GGZ collaboration, so that a client above the 14-week Treeknorm is placed where capacity exists; since 2026 the referral date travels with the client because every zorgprestatiemodel declaration must carry it.

relations.name: Shares records and network care through Quli
relations.description: Discloses dossier data to the client's Quli PGO under MedMij consent and lets the client share it with family and informal carers, alongside the CRS client portal.

relations.name: Contracts e-health and referral integrations for the institution
relations.description: Agrees the connections to Bergop, Therapieland, Minddistrict, ZorgDomein and ZorgMail for all teams and holds the partner to the institution's security requirements.

relations.name: Configures the yearly zorgprestatiemodel changes
relations.description: Applies the 2026 field agreements (mandatory referral date on every declaration, the system therapist added to the professional standards, the transitional benefit retired) and the municipal Jeugdwet and WMO contract settings in the institution's CRS tenant before 1 January, tests them with the application manager against the December closing and briefs the team leads on what changes for registration.

relations.name: Onboards the practice and migrates it into HCI One
relations.description: Migrates and validates data from FysioRoadmap, SpotOnMedics or Incura, configures care pathways and insurer contracts, trains the therapists and runs hypercare for the first declarations.

relations.name: Buys billing services and hands over return messages
relations.description: Outsources declaration submission and return-message handling to the billing service so rejections are corrected and resubmitted without the practice owner's time.

relations.name: Coordinates releases and integration incidents
relations.description: Announces interface changes, tests against versioned partner APIs and escalates incidents so the support desk can inform affected practices before a connection fails.

relations.name: Orders a practice website and front-door activation
relations.description: Chooses a practice website with online booking, e-consult and triage entry points and asks the implementation desk to connect the HIS or AIS and switch on the digital front door.

relations.name: Asks for discipline-specific templates and declaration rules
relations.description: Raises questions about care pathways, measurement instruments and declaration codes for the therapist's discipline and reports issues to the support desk.

relations.name: Connects ParaNICE to the hospital information system
relations.description: Sets up the hospital system link and the remote-care trajectories for the department and supports the team during rollout.
